# netskope_npa_local_broker (Resource)

NPALocalBroker Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_npa_local_broker" "my_npalocalbroker" {
  access_via_public_ip = "ON_OFF_PREM"
  city_name            = "Cupertino"
  country_code         = "US"
  country_name         = "United States of America"
  custom_private_ip    = "192.168.19.119"
  custom_public_ip     = "203.0.113.42"
  label_ids = [
    "696067da-3890-4fe3-a784-8e682e9b7122"
  ]
  latitude          = 37.323
  local_broker_name = "...my_local_broker_name..."
  longitude         = -122.032
  region_name       = "CA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_via_public_ip` (String) Controls access to LBR via public IP. Default: "NONE"; must be one of ["NONE", "OFF_PREM", "ON_PREM", "ON_OFF_PREM"]
- `city_name` (String)
- `country_code` (String)
- `country_name` (String)
- `custom_private_ip` (String) Private IP address of the local broker
- `custom_public_ip` (String) Public IP address of the local broker
- `label_ids` (List of String) Array of label UUIDs to associate with the local broker
- `latitude` (Number) Latitude in decimal degrees
- `local_broker_name` (String)
- `longitude` (Number) Longitude in decimal degrees
- `region_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `assessment` (Attributes) Assessment status of the local broker (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assessment))
- `common_name` (String)
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the local broker was created
- `discovered_private_ip` (String)
- `discovered_public_ip` (String)
- `dns_host` (String) DNS hostname for the local broker
- `gslb_uuid` (String) GSLB UUID for the local broker
- `host_port` (Number) Host port for the local broker
- `local_broker_id` (Number) Local broker id
- `location_id` (String)
- `pop_name` (String) Point of presence name
- `reachable_by_client` (Boolean) Whether the local broker is reachable by clients
- `registered` (Boolean)
- `registered_at` (String) Timestamp when the local broker was registered
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the local broker was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--assessment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assessment`

Read-Only:

- `status` (String) Connection status (e.g., disconnected, connected)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import netskope_npa_local_broker.my_netskope_npa_local_broker 0
```
